newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end weaker, focus on U.S. market.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end weaker, focus on U.S. market.

text.p: Portuguese shares closed weaker on profit taking in modest volume of 7.9 billion escudos as the market accompanied the drop of Wall Street. The PSI20 index of 20 leading shares closed down 0.45 percent to 6,723.97 points. Dealers said they expected the euphoria of investors seen in recent weeks to calm down ahead of the partial privatisation of electricity company EDP-Electricidade de Portugal as some investors sell stocks to raise cash to invest in EDP. Dealers noted that two percent of the capital of Banco Essi had changed hands. They said Banco Espirito Santo might have boosted its stake in Banco Essi. Shares of cement group Cimpor digested a sharp increase in its first quarter profit and closed at 3,814 escudos, down 36, in volume of 235,740 shares. Dealers said foreign markets would probably set the trend in the coming sessions.
